newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds came under pressure from falling Conf futures to end lower overall in quiet trade and thin volume, traders said.
"We were overshadowed by the weak Conf," one dealer said.
Professionals were almost alone amidst a dearth of client orders but there was no real pressure to sell, they said.
Businesss was thin in all segments. "Money continues to flow into Switzerland but it is not coming to the bond market," one dealer said.
Traders said it was difficult to forecast where the market would go.
They said September Conf had now broken through support at 120.50 but on the other hand had also fallen pretty far recently, suggesting a rebound was likely.
Sept Conf futures down 40 to 120.40 percent.
Euro Swiss francs up three to 98.43.
